rule: One base template per family supplies glyph, pain set and default flags; every monster names its base. Colour is the element within one body: the same base is repeated per colour with one element immunity, one breath spell and one swapped blow. A boss is a unique that shares its base with ordinary members, with much higher hit points and depth. The top tier of a family may use a multi-step colour cycle (a palette animation) instead of a static colour. Escorts are defined per base.
keep: one base per family, members name the base
colour as element within one body
slow colour cycle reserved for the top tier
blow method table as a text layer for the attack verb
change: no glyph; the telegraph is a pose and a colour step
cycle is a palette step in our renderer, not the legacy flicker
no unique that shares no base with a family
server rolls member, element and blow from the zone seed
all attack verb text is ours
look_test: One four-member insect base at 375 wide with element colour per member, then the same base as the top tier with a two-frame cycle and a name card. Dom judges: members told apart by colour at fight distance; top tier reads as same family stronger; the cycle draws the eye before the breath.
